item.title: TT-103 Search query syntax
item.brief:
Implement exactly the ticket acceptance criteria below in the registered `long-backlog` repository. Add focused tests for the new behavior, preserve the existing test suite, use only the Python standard library, and run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` before finishing. Keep this ticket's change isolated so it ships as its own commit; do not combine it with another backlog ticket.

Ticket TT-103:
- tasktracker.search.search(tasks, query) splits terms on whitespace except inside double quotes; a quoted phrase is one term. All terms must match (AND).
- Bare words and phrase terms match titles case-insensitively.
- tag:NAME matches an exact tag case-insensitively.
- status:open and status:done match task status.
- Any other field:value term, unknown status, or unterminated quote raises QueryError defined in tasktracker.search.
- Empty/blank query matches every task. Preserve input order.

item.title: TT-104 Undo TaskStore operations
item.brief:
Implement exactly the ticket acceptance criteria below in the registered `long-backlog` repository. Add focused tests for the new behavior, preserve the existing test suite, use only the Python standard library, and run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` before finishing. Keep this ticket's change isolated so it ships as its own commit; do not combine it with another backlog ticket.

Ticket TT-104:
- Add TaskStore.undo() to revert the most recent not-yet-undone add, complete, or delete. Repeated calls walk backward in LIFO order across all operation kinds.
- Undo add removes the task; undo complete reopens it; undo delete restores it exactly, with the same id.
- Ids are never reused, including after undoing an add.
- With no remaining operation, raise NothingToUndo defined in tasktracker.store.
- Failed operations (for example completing an unknown id) are not recorded.

pr.body: TaskStore keeps an in-memory per-instance operation history. Successful add, complete, and delete calls append history only after lookup/validation succeeds. undo() reverses the latest operation and raises NothingToUndo when history is empty. Added tests covering mixed LIFO reversal, preserved IDs, exhausted history, and failed completion. Checks: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . (7 tests, OK); git diff --check (passed). Independent review passed; it noted a nonblocking edge case for undoing complete() on an already-completed task.
pr.summary: Added LIFO undo for task additions, completions, and deletions. Task deletions restore the original task and ID; undone additions do not free IDs. Before: TaskStore operations could not be undone; now callers can reverse the latest successful operation.
pr.title: Add TaskStore undo support

item.title: TT-101 Reject impossible due dates
item.brief:
Implement exactly the ticket acceptance criteria below in the registered `long-backlog` repository. Add focused tests for the new behavior, preserve the existing test suite, use only the Python standard library, and run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` before finishing. Keep this ticket's change isolated so it ships as its own commit; do not combine it with another backlog ticket.

Ticket TT-101:
- In tasktracker.dates.parse_due(text, today), impossible calendar dates (including 2026-02-30, 2025-02-29, 2026-04-31, 2026-13-01, 2026-00-10) raise InvalidDate, a ValueError subclass defined in tasktracker.dates; its message contains the original text.
- Any unsupported form raises InvalidDate rather than bare ValueError.
- Relative +Nd means N days after today; +0d is today. Negative or unsigned offsets (-3d, 3d) raise InvalidDate.
- today and tomorrow continue to work; matching is case-insensitive and ignores surrounding whitespace.
